title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom

title_lang.en: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
title_lang.zh_hk: 超級無敵羊咩咩大電影之怪獸農場

synopsis: SHAUN THE SHEEP: THE BEAST OF MOSSY BOTTOM sees the residents of Mossy Bottom Farm looking forward to Halloween – until the clumsy Farmer trashes the Flock’s beloved pumpkin patch! When Shaun turns MAD SCIENTIST to fix the problem, things rapidly spiral out of control... With The Farmer missing and a wild beast roaming the woods of Mossingham, all the ingredients are in place for a monstrously fun family adventure.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
《咪走雞》《超級無敵羊咩咩大電影》史上 NO.1 賣座定格動畫公司又一好咩巴閉神作！

 

「撞板多過食飯」嘅農夫竟將羊咩咩種下嘅南瓜全部打爛，南瓜田變成「南瓜浴」，今個萬聖節大派對面臨取消！ 於是阿爽變身「瘋狂科學家」發明古怪裝置拯救萬聖節，點知愈救愈大鑊……實驗室爆煲，農夫忽然失蹤，小鎮樹林更驚現「毛神神」怪獸，嚇到全城雞飛狗走！面對「毛」敵大麻煩，阿爽同羊咩咩今次將會用「咩」爆趣方法擊退怪獸、拯救萬聖節？
